note: §9: `badge-only-person` fires under `--posture commons` when a key acts only under badges and has published no self profile. The count is computed **regardless of the declared `subjectKind`** — the issuer must not hold the switch for the check that watches issuers — and the declared composition is printed beside it, which is why `person 1` appears on the line as the issuer's claim rather than as the finding's basis.

kind.description: A one-field resource, so a verifier vector has something harmless to admit.

lines.identities: 1 keys acting only under badges with no self profile
